about: The manor's colour themes, for the Theme menus (the Steward's kit, web/themes.json); themes.css has their colours. name is <html data-theme>'s value (system: none, the page follows Windows); scheme is light or dark; swatch is the page's colour, its accent and its text, as the menu's little circle shows them; group is the menu's heading.

themes.name: system
themes.label: Match Windows
themes.description: Light or dark, as Windows is set.

themes.name: carbon
themes.label: Carbon
themes.description: Carbon fibre with a volt green edge.

themes.label: Quest
themes.description: An old map in ink and parchment.
